documents.summary: A faculty resource page that tells instructors to set clear AI boundaries in the syllabus, offers suggested syllabus language from permissive to prohibitive (behind a login), and lists ways to redesign assignments, limit AI, and spot misuse. documents.title: UNF AI guidelines
documents.stance_why: Coders differed: A delegates, B restrict. The only binding coursework rule is "AI may only be used to complete coursework when authorized via the course syllabus or specific assignment instructions", and "Syllabi will include a statement about acceptable use of AI in the course"; the rest are principles and implications for other policies. The university sets a fallback and hands the actual AI rule to each syllabus or assignment, so delegates.
documents.summary: The university page sets five guiding principles (understand, accountable, integrity, excellence, civil) and a table of how existing policies apply to AI. Coursework use is allowed only when authorized by the syllabus, authorized use is cited, and UNF recommends against AI detectors.
